findings.title: One JSON-LD block does not parse

evidence.observed: The second application/ld+json block ends with a trailing comma before }, so JSON.parse throws at position 118.

findings.expected: Every application/ld+json block parses as JSON.
findings.recommendation: Remove the trailing comma; serialize the block with a JSON encoder instead of a template string.

expected_impact.rationale: A block that does not parse contributes nothing: search engines and answer engines skip it entirely.
